tiktok.e:
🎵 **TikTok:**

🔹 **What it is:** A platform for creating, discovering, and sharing short-form vertical videos, famous for its viral algorithm.
🔹 **Developer:** ByteDance (launched internationally in 2017).
🔹 **Key Features:** For You Page (FYP) algorithm, audio syncing, creative duet/stitch tools, viral trends, and TikTok Shop.
🔹 **Scale:** Over 1.5 Billion monthly active users worldwide!
tiktok.h:
🎵 **TikTok:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Short-form vertical video bananey aur dekhne ka world-famous platform hai jo ByteDance ne banaya hai.
🔹 **Features:** Iska 'For You' algorithm trending aur viral videos dikhata hai. Duets, sound effects aur video filters iske main features hain!
🔹 **Scale:** Duniya bhar mein 1.5 Billion se zyada active users hain.

whatsapp.e:
💬 **WhatsApp:**

🔹 **What it is:** An internationally popular instant messaging app providing end-to-end encrypted text, voice, and video communication.
🔹 **Owner:** Meta (Facebook), acquired in 2014 for ~$19 Billion.
🔹 **Key Features:** End-to-end encryption, voice/video group calls, WhatsApp Web, Status updates, and Channels.
🔹 **Scale:** Over 2.7 Billion active users globally!
whatsapp.h:
💬 **WhatsApp:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Duniya ka sabse bada messaging app hai jo end-to-end encryption ke saath chat, voice aur video call provide karta hai.
🔹 **Owner:** Meta (Facebook).
🔹 **Features:** Secure chat, group video calls, status updates aur WhatsApp Web.
🔹 **Scale:** 2.7 Billion se zyada log ise daily use karte hain!

instagram.e:
📸 **Instagram (IG):**

🔹 **What it is:** A visual-first social network by Meta focused on photo sharing, short videos (Reels), and disappearing daily stories.
🔹 **Founded:** 2010 by Kevin Systrom & Mike Krieger; acquired by Facebook in 2012.
🔹 **Key Features:** Feed posts, 24-hour Stories, Reels algorithm, Direct Messages (DMs), and Explore tab.
🔹 **Scale:** Over 2.4 Billion active users worldwide!
instagram.h:
📸 **Instagram:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Meta ka visual social network jo photo sharing, viral Reels aur 24-ghante ki Stories ke liye mashhoor hai.
🔹 **Features:** Reels, photo filters, DMs, Explore page aur creator tools.
🔹 **Scale:** Duniya bhar mein 2.4 Billion se zyada users hain!

facebook.e:
👥 **Facebook:**

🔹 **What it is:** A major social networking platform founded by Mark Zuckerberg in 2004, allowing users to share posts, join groups, and connect globally.
🔹 **Parent Company:** Meta Platforms.
🔹 **Key Features:** News Feed, Facebook Groups, Marketplace, Watch, and Pages for creators/businesses.
🔹 **Scale:** Over 3 Billion monthly active users — the largest social network in history!
facebook.h:
👥 **Facebook:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Mark Zuckerberg ne 2004 mein launch kiya tha. Yeh duniya ka sabse bada social network hai.
🔹 **Features:** News Feed, Groups, Marketplace, Pages aur video watch.
🔹 **Scale:** 3 Billion se zyada active users hain!

telegram.e:
✈️ **Telegram:**

🔹 **What it is:** A cloud-based instant messaging app recognized for its speed, privacy features, bot ecosystem, and large broadcast channels.
🔹 **Founded:** 2013 by Nikolai and Pavel Durov.
🔹 **Key Features:** Channels with unlimited subscribers, groups up to 200,000 members, custom bots, cloud file storage up to 2GB, and Secret Chats.

✈️ **Telegram:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Pavel Durov dwara banaya gaya ultra-fast cloud messaging app jo privacy aur large channels ke liye jaana jaata hai.

snapchat.e:

🔹 **Key Features:** Disappearing Snaps, AR Face Lenses, Snap Map, Stories, and Spotlight.

🔹 **Kya hai:** America mein doston ke beech bill split karne aur instant paise bhejne ka social payment app hai.

paypal.e:
💳 **PayPal:**

🔹 **What it is:** A pioneer global digital wallet and online payment system supporting secure transactions, currency conversions, and fraud protection worldwide.
paypal.h:
💳 **PayPal:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Worldwide international online payments aur money transfer ka sabse trusted digital wallet hai.

zelle.e:
🏦 **Zelle:**

🔹 **What it is:** A direct bank-to-bank peer-to-peer payment network integrated into thousands of US financial institutions for zero-fee, instant money transfers.
zelle.h:
🏦 **Zelle:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** US bank accounts ke beech bina kisi fee ke direct paise transfer karne ka fast payment network hai.

robinhood.e:
📈 **Robinhood:**

robinhood.h:
📈 **Robinhood:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Commission-free stock market aur crypto trading app hai jo mobile par trading ko aasan banata hai.

coinbase.e:
🪙 **Coinbase:**

🔹 **What it is:** A leading publicly traded cryptocurrency exchange platform providing a secure interface to buy, sell, convert, and store digital assets like Bitcoin and Ethereum.
coinbase.h:
🪙 **Coinbase:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Bitcoin, Ethereum aur crypto khareedne aur bechne ka sabse secure global exchange hai.

slack.e:
💼 **Slack:**

🔹 **What it is:** A business communication hub owned by Salesforce, organizing team messaging into dedicated channels, direct messages, voice huddles, and tool integrations.
slack.h:
💼 **Slack:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Companies aur startups ka workplace chat platform jahan team channels aur workflow automation hoti hai.

notion.e:
📝 **Notion:**

notion.h:
📝 **Notion:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Notes lene, project manage karne, tables banane aur life organize karne ka ultimate all-in-one workspace app hai.

google drive.e:
☁️ **Google Drive:**

google drive.h:
☁️ **Google Drive:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Google ka cloud storage app jahan aap photos, videos aur documents online safe rakh sakte hain.

apple music.e:
🍎 **Apple Music:**

🔹 **What it is:** Apple's premium ad-free audio streaming service offering over 100 Million lossless songs, Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos, and curated Apple Music 1 radio.
apple music.h:
🍎 **Apple Music:**

🔹 **Kya hai:** Apple ka premium ad-free music app jo high-resolution lossless audio aur Dolby Atmos sound deliver karta hai.

soundcloud.e:
☁️ **SoundCloud:**

soundcloud.h:
☁️ **SoundCloud:**

shazam.e:

🎵 **Shazam:**

twitch.e:

🎮 **Twitch:**

hulu.e:

📺 **Hulu:**

crunchyroll.e:

zomato.e:
🍕 **Zomato:**

🍕 **Zomato:**

swiggy.e:

instacart.e:

lyft.e:

🚗 **Lyft:**

waze.e:

google translate.e:

signal.e:

viber.e:

📞 **Viber:**

line.e:

wechat.e:

🇨🇳 **WeChat:**

goodreads.e:

📚 **Goodreads:**

audible.e:

myfitnesspal.e:

flo.e:

flo.h:

calm.e:

headspace.e:

trello.e:

evernote.e:

ring.e:
